conditions.query: The player gets between Bramble the lion and his food, or tries to take food off him.

effects.instruction: Bramble's old and half blind but he still knows where his dinner is: one lazy swipe of a paw the size of a skillet sends them sprawling.

conditions.query: Lucius Gilt, ringmaster of the Gilt Circus, meets the player face to face.

effects.instruction: One of Lucius Gilt's big men is leaning on the hedge at the edge of the camp, not even pretending he isn't watching.
